point_estimate.finding: Arithmetic mean of candidate-minus-baseline per-task success proportions; equal task weights.

outer_unit.finding: Uniform task ID draw reused for both architectures; task identity is paired.

inner_unit.finding: Separate rng.randrange calls for baseline and candidate repeat slots; no paired repeat index and no family/run block draw.

endpoints.finding: Sorted effects; percentile endpoints at .025/.975 with linear interpolation; default 10000 draws differs from preserved 500.

pairing_validation.finding: Task order and repeat counts align; these checks do not validate repeat IDs or shared seeds.

method_note.finding: States resample precomputed task-level deltas, not individual repeats; differs from pinned code.

owner_decisions.exact_next_decision: Specify the population, parameter and uncertainty target: fixed tasks conditional on repeats, or sampled tasks/families.
Specify task/family weights and absent/invalid-family handling before selecting the estimator. Equal-task and balanced equal-family arithmetic do not supply approval.
Name the approved interval procedure and exact code/document versions. Task-delta resampling and task plus independent-arm-repeat resampling differ.
Define matched repeat IDs, seeds, ordering and shared blocks; identify independent sampling units. Equal repeat counts do not prove pairing.
Specify confidence/tails, draw budget, calibration scenarios/seeds and scientific coverage/FPR/width acceptance criteria. No new numerical tolerances are supplied here.
Specify invalid-task/artifact exclusions, outcome-blind adjudication and required sensitivity reporting; preserve original attempts.
Specify common timeout budget, interpretable-artifact requirements and endpoint/denominator handling. Do not invent a Boolean result for an unscored contract error.
Specify any future infrastructure-only recovery policy, action authorization and preservation of originals. This audit authorizes no retry or run.
Specify pre-invocation, worker, transport, contract and scorer failure categories, missingness and denominators; absent score is not zero.
Name the primary comparison/endpoint and any hierarchy or multiplicity rule. Zero exclusion remains an implementation diagnostic, not an approved confirmatory test.
Set meaningful success improvement and acceptable latency/call/cost/maintenance burdens. D-011 keeps quality and burden separate; no new weighted winner score.

Record accepted prerequisites, exact task/scorer/protocol/analysis hashes, named gate owner and explicit signoff before a pre-held-out freeze. JIT-off activation does not supply statistical acceptance.
